result.summary: Found 1 issue: the promotional banner text has extremely low contrast and is barely readable.

issues.description: The promo banner headline '3 free deliveries for you' and subtext 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' are rendered in white/very light text on a pale mint-green background, making them washed out and hard to read.
issues.suggestion: Darken the banner text color or deepen the banner background/gradient so the headline and promo code meet contrast guidelines and are clearly legible.
